details:
Q1: Which repository area should be improved?
Choices:
A. Issue-to-PR workflows; name the affected phase (RECOMMENDED)
B. Orchestrator or polling automation; name the affected behavior
C. Documentation or operator experience; name the affected task
D. Another area; provide the relevant file, component, or workflow
Q2: What observable result should the change deliver?
Choices:
A. Fix a defect; provide actual behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction steps (RECOMMENDED)
B. Add or change a capability; describe the required behavior
C. Improve reliability, performance, or usability; provide a measurable acceptance criterion
